summary: Woodstock Avenue west kerb backing onto dense bush, with cars parked beside it.

drivers.seclusion: Treed bush reserve on the west; nearest homes are across the road, 17 m or more from the line and further from the van.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed road; cars are parked on the west edge, so there is room to stop at the kerb.
drivers.convention: A row of cars parks along this west kerb in both images, so a van blends in.

flags: Signs: 2P parallel Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted
Slope flat in the best section, but up to 19% at the ends
Mapped gate 10 m away with a mapped way round it
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the west side shades the kerb from the afternoon sun; open to the east.
cannot_judge: Whether the gate leads to a track

best_section.where: west kerb opposite the townhouses, where the bush meets the road
